overview: The Stotfield Hotel is a 47-bedroom hotel by the sea in Lossiemouth on the Moray coast. Ten of its en-suite rooms look out over the Moray Firth, and some rooms take three or four people, which suits families or friends sharing. Free Wi-Fi runs throughout the hotel, and Covesea Lighthouse is a nearby landmark.
surfTripFit: Sea-view rooms let you see conditions on the Moray Firth before heading out, and the larger rooms work for small groups sharing a trip.
